operation.summary: Deprecated: the old address of POST /v1/issues, same behaviour

body.name: kind
body.description: bug, feature or applet (an applet request: a new applet, with its portal page, to be built)

body.name: applet
body.description: kind applet only, every field optional: {"name" (120 chars), "what_it_does" (2,000), "devices" (up to 10, 80 chars each), "data_used" (up to 20, 120 chars each), "portal_shows" (2,000)}

body.name: no_autofix
body.description: true = leave it for a person (features and applet requests always are)

body.name: images
body.description: Fixer Mode only: up to 5 {"data_base64"} images

body.name: agent_info
body.description: About you, sent with the issue to the Bridgit team: e.g. {"harness":"Claude Code","harness_version":"2.3.1","model":"Claude Opus 5.5"} (up to 20 short string, number or boolean fields)

operation.returns: id (use in URLs), ref and number (the team-wide number, e.g. A0042; null until the phone sends it to the Bridgit team, then GET url shows it), status, no_autofix, kind, applet (applet requests), sent_to_team, url (check back with GET), followup_url, team_api {base_url, key_endpoint, docs}
